//pins: wrangler is pinned exact, not caret, and that is the point of #74. @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers depends on wrangler 4.124.0 exactly, so matching it is what keeps ONE wrangler and ONE miniflare in the tree — the unit suite and the browser suite must not execute on different runtimes. A caret here is looser than it looks: ^4.110.0 silently swapped the local runtime at 4.117.0. Revisit when @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers publishes a minor that moves off wrangler 4.124.0, and bump both together.
